resources.string: Notification channel for audio playback controls
RunBeat is a BPM-based audio player designed for runners. It adjusts the tempo of your music (time-stretching without changing the pitch) so your playlist always matches your target running cadence.
Pick a target cadence for your run (default 172 BPM, range 160-195) and RunBeat continuously matches the music to it as you run.
Track BPMs are detected automatically using Aubio, can be entered by tapping along to the beat, or imported from pre-analyzed CSV files.

To keep your steps in time with the music, choose how the beat divides: Binary (1x or 2x, a two-beat subdivision) or Ternary (1.5x or 3x, a three-beat subdivision). Enable one or both and RunBeat picks the closest match.
